verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs state that Pods are billed by the second for compute and storage, and that all compute and storage charges are billed per second. Serverless is billed from when a worker starts until it fully stops, rounded up to the nearest second, and Flex workers scale to zero when idle. Pods can be stopped and started, which implies compute charges end when a Pod is stopped, though the docs do not say so explicitly. missing for 10: explicit documentation that stopped Pods incur no compute charges (storage billing continues), independent or hands-on corroboration of the per-second billing behavior.
